title: Curve founder says DeFi must ditch token emissions for real revenue
summary: Curve founder Michael Egorov told Cointelegraph that protocols cannot “live without real revenues flowing” as token incentives lose power to attract liquidity.

title: Standard Chartered sticks to $2T stablecoin call but trims T-bill impact
summary: Standard Chartered slashed its forecast for T-bill demand from stablecoins to $800 billion to $1 trillion by 2028, but maintained its $2 trillion stablecoin market call.

title: Fictional 2028 AI memo imagines mass layoffs and stablecoin adoption
summary: Citrini Research’s 2028 scenario imagines AI turbocharging corporate profits, while hollowing out consumer demand and quietly migrating global payments to stablecoins on cheap chains.

title: Austria’s regulator slaps new business ban on KuCoin’s EU exchange
summary: The Austrian Financial Market Authority has frozen new business at KuCoin EU months after granting the exchange a MiCA license, citing gaps in key AML and sanctions roles.

title: Strategy adds 592 BTC for $40M in 100th Bitcoin purchase
summary: Strategy bought 592 Bitcoin for $39.8 million in its 100th purchase, increasing holdings to 717,722 BTC.

title: How SocialFi, memecoins and AI pushed Base to the top of the L2 ladder
summary: Base rode SocialFi, memecoins and AI agents to the top of Ethereum’s layer-2 ladder before turning inward to rebuild its core stack.

title: Bitmine paper loss nears $8.8B as Ether slump tests cyclical thesis
summary: The mounting unrealized losses of Bitmine shareholders and Ether’s 60% decline are signaling a critical inflection point that may define Ether’s medium-term momentum, analysts said.

title: Crypto funds lose $288M as ETPs extend outflow run to five weeks
summary: Crypto investment products posted outflows for a fifth straight week, marking the longest exit streak since the launch of spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2024.

title: Bitcoin treasuries log rare selling streak as BTC trades near $66K
summary: Continued selling from treasury companies and US Bitcoin ETFs threatens a deeper retracement for BTC, but some analysts see it as a sign of a healthy flush in speculative leverage.

title: Bank of Korea renews call for bank-led won stablecoins as bill stalls
summary: The Bank of Korea proposed a bank-led consortium and a statutory interagency body for issuer approvals, citing the US GENIUS Act as a model, according to local media.
